summary.zh: 把墙从边界变成可连续借力的移动节点。
summary.en: Turn walls from boundaries into reusable movement anchors.

rules.zh: 贴近墙面后跳离，借助另一面墙或空中调整继续上升。玩家要在墙距、危险物和落点之间规划节奏；失败通常来自方向或时机，而非缺少一把钥匙。
rules.en: Jump away from a wall, then use another wall or air control to continue rising. Plan around wall spacing, hazards and landing points; failure mainly tests timing and direction rather than key possession.

loop.en: Catch the next wall or platform

decisions.zh: 贴墙多停一会儿更容易看清路线，却可能滑向危险。
decisions.en: Waiting on a wall can reveal the route but may slide the character into danger.

decisions.zh: 连续高速蹬墙更快，停在安全平台则能重新校准。
decisions.en: Fast consecutive jumps save time; a safe platform provides a reset.

effect.zh: 推力大强调两墙交替，推力小允许沿同一墙反复攀升。
effect.en: Strong push favors alternating walls; weak push supports repeated jumps up one wall.

effect.zh: 转向宽松降低失误代价，惯性强则需要提前规划。
effect.en: Generous control softens mistakes; strong inertia requires earlier planning.

implementation.zh: 角色可以在墙上滑动并蹬墙跳；高速移动与密集锯片让同一基础动作需要精确路线。
implementation.en: The character slides on walls and wall-jumps; fast movement and dense saw hazards demand precise routes from this basic action.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：观察锯片与竖直墙面之间的安全缝隙；此图不展示完整跳跃轨迹。
observation.en: System reference: inspect safe gaps between saws and walls; the full jump trajectory is not shown.

implementation.zh: 螳螂爪获得后，贴住完全竖直的表面即可下滑并再次跳起，可连续重复。
implementation.en: After acquiring Mantis Claw, pressing against a vertical surface enables sliding and repeated jumps away from it.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：观察右侧竖直墙面、平台与尖刺的关系；单帧不证明已执行蹬墙跳。
observation.en: System reference: inspect the right-hand wall, platform and spikes; a wall jump is not demonstrated by this still.

contrast.zh: 《超级肉肉哥》把蹬墙当作开局就要精通的技能；《空洞骑士》还把它作为扩展世界可达性的阶段奖励。
contrast.en: Super Meat Boy makes wall jumping a baseline skill to master; Hollow Knight also uses it as a progression reward that expands world access.

combination.zh: 设计提案：只允许在被玩家墨水染色的墙面蹬跳，路线选择与有限涂料分配一起决定上升路径。
combination.en: Design proposal: allow wall jumps only on surfaces painted by the player, combining route execution with a limited paint supply.

setup.zh: 两面墙之间有落脚台，上方的刺迫使你改变蹬墙节奏。
setup.en: Two walls lead to a ledge, with spikes above forcing a change of rhythm.

action.zh: 你从左墙跳向右墙，在刺下方再次反向蹬出。
action.en: Jump from the left wall to the right, then push off again below the spikes.

result.zh: 高度增加，但每次转向都改变了到落脚台的距离。
result.en: You gain height, while each reversal changes the distance to the ledge.

next.zh: 落上平台重新观察下一段，或继续蹬墙追求更快通过。
next.en: Land to inspect the next section or keep climbing for a faster route.

firstStep.zh: 先做一条双墙竖井、固定跳跃曲线和一个安全平台。
firstStep.en: Start with a two-wall shaft, a consistent jump arc, and one safe platform.

pitfall.zh: 贴墙判定、转向和按键宽容需要统一；先别用狭小关卡掩盖操作问题。
pitfall.en: Unify wall contact, turning, and input forgiveness before building tight challenges.

test.zh: 观察新玩家是否能连续蹬墙上升，并把失败归因到可理解的时机或方向。
test.en: See whether new players can climb repeatedly and understand failed timing or direction.
